description: Represents a hyperlink attached to a spreadsheet cell. Supports web URLs, email links, internal cell references, and named ranges.

properties.name: Kind
properties.description: The kind of hyperlink: Web, Email, InternalRef, or NamedRange.

properties.name: Target
properties.description: The hyperlink target. URL for Web, email address for Email, A1 ref for InternalRef, range name for NamedRange.

properties.name: Display
properties.description: Optional display text shown in the cell instead of the target.

properties.name: EmailSubject
properties.description: For Email hyperlinks, an optional subject line.

examples.title: Create a web hyperlink
